label_units: 450-second mean halted vehicles per controlled lane; candidate first 10 seconds, then PhasePressure
score_units: Group-normalized predicted score; compare advantage signs, not raw score/label RMSE
scoring: Original _rigid_score and reference-first / state-lexical tie-break; existing model, no refit
limitations: Unused groups share training seeds and nearby times; not independent-seed validation.
Labels estimate one candidate action followed by PhasePressure; they do not measure a continuing rigid closed loop.
The nine unsafe branch groups remain excluded as in the original collection; conclusions concern the retained action groups.
